composition.serve_who: This sheet (AFT BLOCK B: DANFOSS PVG 32/16 - 3 FUNCTIONS) serves the Stern Thruster system (461-stern-thruster-oms-h250), exclusively. Three slices — STERN THRUSTER (EV-9.1), S.T. UP/DOWN (EV-9.2), and S.T. LOCK (EV-9.3) — all name the stern thruster in their labels, matching the engineer-confirmed pressure_settings fact already attached to 461-stern-thruster-oms-h250 (EV-9.1/9.2/9.3 bar values). No other equipment is named on this sheet. The block's own inlet/LS/rail structure is shared manifold infrastructure serving all three functions together (Danfoss PVG 32/16 AFT block B, node 570-danfoss-pvg-32-16-aft-blockb).

functions.label: STERN THRUSTER (azimuth/rotation drive)
functions.sheet_region: left third of sheet, x~0.33-0.47, PVG32 module under 'STERN THRUSTER' heading
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally drives the stern thruster rotation/azimuth actuator to STBD or PORT via a proportional pilot module (PVEU) acting on an open-neutral main spool.
key_components: Proportional pilot module (PVEU 0-10V) driving main spool - part 11166832
Main proportional directional spool, open-neutral center - part 157B7123
Work-port relief valves on A and B lines, set to 280 bar each (part 157B2280 x2) - protect actuator hoses from over-pressure
LS limiter cartridges on LS_A and LS_B branches, set to 250 bar each - cap the load-sense signal sent to the pump/compensator
Shuttle/check network selecting LS signal from active work port

flow_scenarios.path: P enters module, passes through open-center spool directly to T return; A and B work ports isolated from load; LS_A/LS_B relieved toward tank via their 250 bar limiter cartridges.

PVEU pilot shifts spool: P → A port → off-sheet to STBD-side thruster actuator; return oil from B port → spool → T; LS signal taken from A-side path, capped at 250 bar by the LS_A limiter; if A-port load exceeds 280 bar the A work-port relief (157B2280) opens, dumping excess to the common P/T rail.

PVEU pilot shifts spool opposite: P → B port → off-sheet to PORT-side thruster actuator; return oil from A port → spool → T; LS signal taken from B-side path, capped at 250 bar by the LS_B limiter; if B-port load exceeds 280 bar the B work-port relief (157B2280) opens, dumping excess to the common P/T rail.

functions.dry_data: PVG 32 module, spool 65 l/min, PVEU proportional 0-10V actuation, open-neutral spool position

functions.label: S.T. UP/DOWN (thruster lift/lower)
functions.sheet_region: center of sheet, x~0.47-0.63, PVG16 module under 'S.T. UP/DOWN' heading
functions.what_it_does: Raises or lowers the stern thruster unit via an ON/OFF pilot module (PVEO) on a closed-center spool; load-sensing pressure is capped for this function.
key_components: PVEO ON/OFF pilot solenoid module - part 11166838
Closed-center main directional spool blocking P, A, B in neutral
Work-port protective cartridges on A and B lines (relief/anti-cavitation type)
Load-sensing pressure relief set to 100 bar (per engineer red-pen), limiting LS pressure for this function

flow_scenarios.path: Spool centered, P blocked, both A and B work ports isolated — no flow to the lift/lower actuator.
PVEO pilot shifts spool: P → A port → off-sheet to thruster lift actuator (UP); return oil from B port → spool → T rail; load-sensing pressure capped at 100 bar by the LS relief for this function.

PVEO pilot shifts spool opposite: P → B port → off-sheet to thruster lift actuator (DOWN); return oil from A port → spool → T rail; load-sensing pressure capped at 100 bar by the LS relief for this function.

functions.dry_data: PVG 16 module, spool 5 l/min, PVEO ON/OFF actuation, closed-neutral spool position; UP=A, DOWN=B

functions.label: S.T. LOCK (stow/deploy lock cylinder)
functions.sheet_region: right third of sheet, x~0.63-0.8, PVG16 module under 'S.T. LOCK' heading
functions.what_it_does: Extends or retracts the stern thruster lock cylinder (IN/OUT) via an ON/OFF pilot module (PVEO) on a closed-center spool, securing the thruster unit in its housing when not in use.
key_components: PVEO ON/OFF pilot solenoid module - part 11166838
Closed-center main directional spool blocking P, A, B in neutral
Load-sensing pressure relief set to 70 bar (per engineer red-pen), limiting LS pressure for this function

flow_scenarios.path: Spool centered, P blocked, both A (IN) and B (OUT) ports isolated — lock cylinder holds position.
PVEO pilot shifts spool: P → A port → off-sheet to lock cylinder (IN/locked); return oil from B port → spool → T rail; load-sensing pressure capped at 70 bar by the LS relief for this function.

PVEO pilot shifts spool opposite: P → B port → off-sheet to lock cylinder (OUT/unlocked); return oil from A port → spool → T rail; load-sensing pressure capped at 70 bar by the LS relief for this function.

functions.dry_data: PVG 16 module, spool 5 l/min, PVEO ON/OFF actuation, closed-neutral spool position; IN=A, OUT=B

infrastructure.system_name: Danfoss PVG 32/16 AFT block B — manifold/rail infrastructure
facts: Shared P (pressure inlet), T (tank return), M (measurement port), LS/LS_A/LS_B (load-sense) rails run the full width of the block, common to all three EV-9.x slices
Standalone reduced-pressure valve in the block inlet section (near M/LS rails, left of EV-9.1) supplies the spool control (pilot) pressure for the slices

Block inlet section carries a pressure-limiter cartridge set to 300 bar — this is the main block pressure relief (per engineer convention for inlet-section reliefs), protecting the whole PVG 32/16 AFT block B manifold
